scope: dev only; 60 fixed score IDs per domain; 16 excluded exemplar IDs; 112 final IDs left for manager
round0: v0 blocks unchanged, v0p exclusion pool expanded
example_construction: Static worked examples use only the fixed exemplar pool. Clause/atomic examples are subproblems of pool items, tagged with their source item ID. Existing domain gold functions format these static examples offline; execution code is unchanged.
code_assistance: S0/S1 have no answer-computing runtime code. S3/S4 retain exactly the harness code assistance documented in DESIGN_V2 and each raw record.
inference: Only python -m v2.harness run, dev, qwen3:1.7b,qwen3:8b, S0,S1,S3,S4. Shared GPU lock held by harness. Calls/warmups journaled in each run directory.
selection: Maximize mean accuracy across two models on score IDs; tie picks earliest round. S2 copies S0. Final prompts will not be run by this worker.
scope_note: HANDOFF.md and managers files are outside the task write allowlist; P1 handoff will be in results/v2/prompt_dev.
